title: Project scripts and reproducible installs
description: Create portable package scripts and a clean installation workflow that fails when a syntax or test check fails, then verify it in an isolated copy.
objectives: Explain npm run scripts and execution exit codes
Create portable syntax-check and test commands
Verify reproducibility in a fresh project directory
rubric: I created independent check, test and verification scripts.
I triggered a real test failure, inspected its exit code and repaired it.
I passed the clean-install verification tests.
